Yep — found the culprit. The flyover uses authored labels for dungeon entrances, but ordinary landmarks are generated directly from IDs:

`bear_cave → Bear Cave`, `human_mine → Human Mine`, `old_well → Old Well`, etc.

So the cinematic is faithfully exposing implementation names instead of lore names. The fix belongs in the landmark definitions: add authored display titles and have the flyover use those.
I just feel lke we could these things much better, more creative names -- even if it's just a "Display Name" and we keep th internal identifiers as they sit.

Absolutely. I’ll keep the stable IDs untouched and add a presentation-only title field to the landmark definitions, then route the flyover through it. I’m using the landmark/content authoring and camera guidance because this crosses authored world content and display-only cinematic labeling.
